title.zh: 伊朗威胁将冲突扩大至区域外，若美国重启对德黑兰的打击
title.en: Iran threatens to extend conflict 'beyond region' if U.S. resumes attacks

summary.en: Markets navigate Middle East escalation risk amid inflation fears; 10Y yields retreat to 4.64% as bond pricing wariness grows. Nvidia earnings tomorrow anchors tech attention, while geopolitics keeps energy elevated despite oil dips on peace-talk headlines.
summary.zh: 市场在中东局势升级风险与通胀担忧间寻找平衡；10 年期美债收益率退至 4.64%，债市谨慎情绪升温。英伟达明日财报成为科技板块焦点，地缘政治支撑油价高位。

title.zh: 特朗普推迟对伊朗军事行动

summary.en: US markets opened mixed as Trump's postponement of Iran military strike eased geopolitical tensions, though chip stocks weighed on sentiment amid inflation concerns. Oil prices remain elevated above $110/barrel, keeping energy sector supported while Treasury yields climbed to 4.68%.
summary.zh: 美股早盘震荡，特朗普推迟对伊朗军事行动缓解地缘紧张，但芯片股拖累市场情绪，通胀担忧犹存。油价维持在 110 美元/桶以上支撑能源板块，美债收益率攀升至 4.68%。

title.zh: 降级推动 10Y 美债收益率降至约 4.35%
title.en: De-escalation Drives 10Y Treasury Yield Down to ~4.35%

summary.en: 10Y Treasury Yield declined from 4.45% Thursday toward 4.35% on de-escalation. Yield compression supports duration assets. The relationship between two-year and ten-year yields remains in focus. Fed policy uncertainty persists; Powell June meeting critical. Rate-sensitive assets rally. Watch for USD flows and inflation expectation shifts.
summary.zh: 10Y 美债收益率从周四 4.45% 下降至约 4.35% 因去升级。收益率压缩支持久期资产。市场仍关注 2 年期和 10 年期美债收益率之间的利差。Fed 政策不确定性犹存；鲍威尔 6 月会议关键。利率敏感资产 上涨。关注美元资金流向和通胀预期转变。

title.zh: Trump-Xi 峰会：贸易休战延长和战略稳定框架
title.en: Trump-Xi Summit: Trade Truce Extension and Strategic Stability Framework

summary.en: US markets advance as Trump-Xi summit delivers trade truce extension but Middle East stalemate fuels inflation concerns. S&P 500 and Nasdaq extend gains to fresh highs while 10Y Treasury yield surges to 4.53% on inflation data. Brent crude jumps to $108/barrel on Iran conflict uncertainty creating stagflation toggle risk. New Fed Chair Warsh faces complex inflation picture with CPI at 3.8% and PPI at 6%.
summary.zh: 特朗普与习近平会晤后，贸易休战得以延长，美股上涨，标普 500 和纳指再创新高。中东僵局仍在加剧通胀担忧；布伦特原油因伊朗局势未明而升至每桶 108 美元。通胀数据推动 10 年期美债收益率升至 4.53%。CPI 和 PPI 分别上涨 3.8% 和 6%，新任美联储主席沃什面临复杂的通胀形势。

title.zh: 北京 Trump-Xi 峰会：贸易战降级和市场准入承诺
title.en: Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing: Trade War De-escalation and Market Access Promises

summary.en: US stocks trade higher ahead of Trump-Xi summit as tech rally extends with S&P 500 and Nasdaq at fresh record highs driven by AI chip demand. Brent crude stabilizes above $104/barrel on Iran ceasefire uncertainty creating stagflation toggle risk. 10Y Treasury yield near 4.46% supports duration assets despite geopolitical premium. Market positioning favors growth names as mega-cap tech leads ahead of NVDA earnings on May 20.
summary.zh: 特朗普与习近平会晤前，美股走高。AI 芯片需求推动科技股延续涨势，标普 500 和纳指再创新高。伊朗停火前景仍不明朗，布伦特原油维持在每桶 104 美元以上，滞胀风险仍受关注。10 年期美债收益率约为 4.46%。市场配置偏向成长股，大型科技股在英伟达 5 月 20 日公布财报前领涨。

title.zh: 特朗普抵达北京举行关键会晤
title.en: Trump Lands in Beijing for High-Stakes Xi Summit

summary.en: U.S. markets approach a pivotal Trump-Xi summit in Beijing amid persistent inflation concerns, with April PPI jumping 6% annually and wholesale prices rising 0.5% month-on-month. Oil prices remain elevated above $107/barrel on Middle East tensions while Treasury yields hit new yearly highs near 4.46%, creating a complex risk-off backdrop for equities.
summary.zh: 美国市场在特朗普访华之际迎来关键节点，通胀担忧持续，4 月 PPI 年增 6%、批发物价月增 0.5%。油价因中东紧张维持在每桶 107 美元以上，美债收益率触及年内新高 4.46%，为股市营造复杂防御性背景。

title.zh: 4 月 CPI 飙升至 3.8% - 三年最热点
title.en: April CPI Accelerates to 3.8% - Hottest in Three Years

summary.en: US stock futures decline as April CPI accelerated to 3.8% - highest in nearly three years - while oil prices surge above $104/barrel amid escalating Iran tensions, forcing markets to price in potential Fed rate hikes.
summary.zh: 美股市期货下跌，4 月 CPI 加速至 3.8% - 近三年来最高，同时伊朗紧张局势升级推动油价突破每桶 104 美元，市场开始定价美联储可能加息。

title.zh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗和平提议 - 地缘政治风险溢价高企
title.en: Trump Rejects Iran Peace Proposal - Geopolitical Risk Premiums Elevated

summary.en: US futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal, keeping geopolitical risk elevated. Strong April jobs report (115K vs 62K consensus) reinforced higher-for-longer rates. AI momentum remains intact with semiconductor giants leading, while oil fluctuates near $100/bbl and gold slips on inflation fears.
summary.zh: 美股期货下跌 0.2%，因特朗普拒绝伊朗和平提议，地缘政治风险高企。强劲的 4 月就业报告（11.5 万 vs 6.2 万共识）强化了更高更持久的利率预期。AI 势头依然强劲，半导体巨头领先，油价徘徊在每桶 100 美元附近，黄金因通胀担忧下滑。

title.zh: 市场因美中伊朗和平协议乐观情绪上涨；原油暴跌
title.en: Markets Rally on US-Iran Peace Deal Optimism; Oil Plunges

summary.en: US stocks extend gains on optimism over US-Iran peace prospects as crude oil drops, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures near record highs while Dow lags. Oil plunges toward $100/barrel on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes, easing inflation fears and supporting risk-on sentiment. Treasury yields compress as de-escalation narrative strengthens; sector rotation shifts from energy to tech as stagflation concerns abate. Fed policy uncertainty persists with rate-cut expectations intact.
summary.zh: 市场对美伊和平前景转趋乐观，美股延续涨势。市场预期霍尔木兹海峡可能重开，油价跌向每桶 100 美元，缓解了通胀担忧。标普 500 和纳指期货接近纪录高位，道指表现相对落后。随着地缘紧张缓和，美债收益率回落，资金从能源股转向科技股。美联储政策前景仍不明朗，市场仍预期降息。

title.zh: 美股接近纪录高位， awaited 伊朗对美国提案回应
title.en: US Stocks Near Records as Iran Response to US Proposal Expected

summary.en: US stock futures edge higher near record highs as investors await Iran's reply to US peace proposal. Oil rebounds to ~$102/barrel on Middle East tensions, supporting energy sector. Tech remains resilient with AI momentum; 10Y Treasury yield stabilizes at 4.37%. Sector rotation continues between energy cyclicals and rate-sensitive growth names.
summary.zh: 美股期货在接近历史高位时小幅上涨，投资者等待伊朗对美国和平提议的回应。中东紧张推动油价回升至约$102/桶，支撑能源板块。科技股表现稳健，AI 动量持续；10 年期美债收益率稳于 4.37%。板块轮动在能源周期股和利率敏感成长股之间持续。

title.zh: 美伊和平协议临近；特朗普暂停'自由行动'
title.en: US-Iran Peace Deal Nears; Trump Pauses 'Project Freedom'

summary.en: Markets rally on Iran peace deal optimism as oil retreats 6-8% and yields tumble; ADP jobs beat expectations while AMD earnings surge drives chip sector. Geopolitical de-escalation shifts sentiment, though labor strength complicates Fed rate-cut narrative ahead of Friday's NFP.
summary.zh: 市场因伊朗和平谈判进展而上涨，油价回落 6-8%，收益率下滑；ADP 就业数据超预期，AMD 财报大涨推动芯片板块。地缘政治缓和转变情绪，但劳动力市场走强使美联储降息叙事复杂化，本周五非农数据关键。

title.zh: 中东局势升级：美伊在霍尔木兹海峡冲突
title.en: Middle East Tensions Escalate: U.S.-Iran Clash in Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: U.S. stock futures mixed as Middle East tensions dominate. U.S.-Iran flare-up in Strait of Hormuz is driving oil prices higher and inflating inflation risks. Investors are weighing geopolitical escalation against resilient earnings, with sector rotation toward energy and away from rate-sensitive growth.
summary.zh: 美股期指走势分化，中东紧张局势主导盘前焦点。美国与伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的冲突升级推动油价飙升，引发通胀担忧。投资者在稳健财报与地缘风险之间权衡，资金向能源板块轮动，避开对利率敏感的成长股。

title.zh: GameStop 突袭提出 560 亿美元收购 eBay
title.en: GameStop Makes Surprise $56B Takeover Bid for eBay

summary.en: US stocks hover near record highs as markets digest GameStop's surprise $56B eBay takeover bid and assess US-Iran peace progress. Oil jumps 5% on Strait of Hormuz tensions, creating stagflation concerns even as futures show muted gains.
summary.zh: 美股在纪录高位附近徘徊，市场消化 GameStop 对 eBay 的 560 亿美元突袭收购要约，并评估美伊和平进展。因霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势油价上涨 5%，引发滞胀担忧，尽管期货涨幅有限。

title.zh: 中东供应风险推动油价维持在 $109 附近，布油溢价持续
title.en: Oil Holds Near $109 on Middle East Supply Risk, Brent Premium Persists

summary.en: US equities open mixed with tech strength offsetting energy headwinds. S&P 500 at 7,230, Nasdaq +0.89% as cloud/AI leaders rally. Oil remains elevated near $109/barrel on Middle East tensions. 10Y Treasury at 4.37% with stable yields. Markets digest Fed policy uncertainty amid record FOMC dissent.
summary.zh: 美股开盘震荡，科技股强势抵消能源领域压力。标普 500 在 7,230 点，纳指 +0.89% 受云/AI 龙头带动。中东紧张推动油价维持 $109/桶高位。10 年期美债收益率 4.37% 保持稳定。联邦公开市场委员会的分歧达到纪录水平，投资者正消化美联储政策前景的不确定性。

title.zh: 伊朗战争担忧推动油价触及 4 年高位，布油升破 114 美元
title.en: Oil Strikes 4-Year High on Iran War Fears, Brent Surges Above $114

summary.en: Oil surges to 4-year highs amid Iran war escalation, pushing Brent above $114/barrel and raising inflation concerns. US stocks close near record highs as tech earnings offset energy-driven headwinds. Fed policy uncertainty persists with record-level dissent.
summary.zh: 油价因伊朗战争升级飙升至 4 年高位，布油突破 114 美元/桶，引发通胀担忧。美股收盘逼近历史高位，科技财报抵消能源领域压力。Fed 政策不确定性持续，分歧达纪录水平。

title.zh: Fed 维持利率不变，Powell 在分歧达 1992 年来最高水平下发表最终记者会
title.en: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Powell Delivers Final Press Conference Amid 1992-Level Dissent

summary.en: Fed holds rates steady amid record dissent as Iran-UAE geopolitical tensions reshape oil supply outlook. Powell's final press conference underscores policy uncertainty, while market recalibrates on OPEC dynamics and energy security risks.
summary.zh: Fed 维持利率不变，分歧程度达 1992 年来最高，伊朗-阿联酋地缘政治紧张重塑石油供应前景。Powell 的最终记者会凸显政策不确定性，市场对 OPEC 格局和能源安全风险重新定价。

title.zh: 中东局势推动油价突破 110 美元
title.en: Oil Surges Above $110 on Middle East Tensions

summary.en: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East push oil above $110, reigniting inflation concerns as Fed policy uncertainty looms ahead of big tech earnings. Tech futures slip on AI jitters despite record highs, while energy names benefit from the oil surge.
summary.zh: 中东地缘政治紧张推高油价突破 110 美元，通胀担忧再起，科技巨头即将公布财报，美联储政策前景仍不明朗。科技股期货因 AI 相关担忧走弱，尽管指数仍处高位；能源股因油价上涨受益。

title.zh: 美伊和谈受阻、霍尔木兹运输仍受限，油价升至两周高位
title.en: Oil jumps to a two-week high as U.S.-Iran peace talks stall and Hormuz shipments remain limited

summary.en: U.S. equity futures are leaning modestly higher, but the real premarket story is cross-asset tension: oil is extending its surge above $109 as U.S.-Iran talks stall and Strait of Hormuz flows stay constrained, while the 10-year Treasury yield edges up to about 4.35%. That keeps the tape investable for tech, but more fragile for the broad market because higher energy and firmer yields revive inflation-risk concerns.
summary.zh: 美股期货盘前偏强，但真正的主线在跨资产：由于美伊谈判受阻、霍尔木兹海峡运输仍受限制，油价继续冲到 109 美元上方；与此同时，10 年期美债收益率回到约 4.35%。这意味着科技股情绪还能撑住，但大盘层面更脆弱，因为更高的能源价格和收益率重新抬升了通胀风险。
